title: Ethiopian Avocado Smoothie
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Avocado Smoothie — ripe Ethiopian highland avocado blended with banana, oat milk, honey, and cardamom. The modern health café version of the avocado juice tradition — thicker, more nutritious, and completely satisfying as a meal replacement.
longDesc: The avocado smoothie is the evolution of the Ethiopian avocado juice tradition (ETH221) — with banana for sweetness, oat milk for creaminess, and cardamom for the Ethiopian character. The health café breakfast staple of Addis Ababa.
ingredients: 1 cup oat milk or regular milk
steps: Combine avocado, banana, milk, honey, and cardamom in blender.
chefTips: Very ripe avocado and banana are essential.
Cardamom is the Ethiopian signature — do not omit.
cookingScience: The banana's natural sugars and the avocado's fat create a self-emulsifying smoothie — no added oil or emulsifier needed.
healthBenefits: Very high healthy fats from avocado.
culturalNote: The Ethiopian avocado smoothie is Addis Ababa's health café contribution to the global smoothie culture — Ethiopian highland avocado (larger and richer than imported varieties) produces a smoothie of extraordinary creaminess that has no global equivalent.
